reviews.review:
Reaching 100 hours now so it felt like a good time to spit out some pros and cons, to whoever is interested in a honest review:

1- I guess it's not rocket science to figure this point by yourself: Dont play this game if you dont like games with very, and i mean VERY sexualized characters. Not in a background/story sense, but more with the 1 million possibilities to costumize them being 999,999,999 cute & sexy options. Accept it.. Even youre not into it, most people around you will be wearing VERY revealing outfits. Is not something that will influentiate your gameplay at all, but your descendants will be ALL very attractive and beautiful and the means of costumize them with outfits and such, will always push more into the "Lets show as much skin possible" in a somehow reasonable and fun/cool looking way.

2- Grinding maybe will feel hard and frustrating sometimes, but trust me and others when we say: It was wayyyyyy harder back on start. Devs are doing a fairly good job imho, buffing this and that, increasing the chances of obtaining X or Y, and probably the most welcoming factor for newcomers being regular events where you can get a wide variety of vital things for free. And that leads me to the next and extremely important point in my eyes.

3- Micro transactions are 100% optional. Sure you can make a big list of games that work the same way, but this game does a pretty awesome job balancing the "Attracting players by offering free stuff vs Draining the wallets of the ones who stay and willingly want to buy things" - Dont get me wrong, i say this in a good sense. For exemple, if you enjoy the game, is fun progressing, unlocking new descendants etc. You grind hard and while at it, you think that would be cool to have another outfit/look on your descendant? Well, you can fairly easy get a free and tbf nice looking outfit. 

3.1- Between the multiple methods, i need to compliment the attendance events that been going non-stop, and the insertion of the attendace coins that you earn along the process and can spend in case you missed some days to claim rewards. With a simple login offering outfits, descendants, consumables and so much more. I found that pretty newcomer friendly and overal rewardingly positive towoards the player base.

3.3- The devs make a pretty good job constantly adding new and fun cosmetics to the in-game shop regularly. Which means, if you are into buying with real money cool stuff for your descendants you have a pretty wide variety for what i would call 'Average & affordable prices' - No different from the majority of games you can get a cool looking outfit or pass for around 10-20 bucks. Means to support the game, as also satisfy your visual look in-game are completly optional, which i feel once more, it needs to be complimented.

4- As briefly mentioned before, the devs been doing (At least in my eyes) a fairly good job adding new content and diversifying the game with time. Yes, you can as i at somepoint find yourself thinking "Hey this is getting boring and repetitive, i made this mission 400 times already" But, and thats a big BUT.. Updates are very regular, you been getting a new descendants if im not in mistake every 3-4 months. Between that time as it happened in past SUPER nice adds came along like companions and rides. So yeah, imho if they had been doing a great work keeping the new content pace steady and fast, i can see the future being promising. And not (at least that soon) driving players towards the path where your time ingame keeps getting repeatitve and pointless.

4.2- A mixed opinion, but i honestly love this game, yet is not a game i would play daily specially for multiple hours. The approach a player gives to it, is vital to form a opinion, and i would highly recomend playing it casually and sporadicaly. Come by today play a ton of hours, dont come by tomorrow for exemple. A constant daily intense grind will make you bored fast, and what im trying to say here is that if you play this game moderatly and casually you will most likely be hooked long-term like me. Coming back now and then, getting excited with new updates. Same way i can rate an overall positive, fun and satisfying experience from everytime i login since launch.

5- The comunity is very friendly in my opinion. Maybe i get lucky with folks i met? Maybe is my server? I have no clue, so im just stating a brief and personal experience of how i always felt players are either doing their own thing, not bothering or wanting to be bothered. Or most important if you try to reach out and ask for help, get some to tag along for X mission you will most likely not struggle to get a pelasent and friendly experience.

Im just trying to be honest here, and i cant really point much cons. I can understand how others may see some negative sides on this game that drives them off, but based on my 100 hours i genuinely like it. In terms of visuals and gameplay is pretty and well built. In terms of transactions you can either support the game and get some extra looks or whatever, as you also can not spend nothing and have a long.term obtainable variety of things for free. 

The game comunity is overal friendly imho, and both the players as also game mechanics are newcomer friendly. The updates, bug fixes and new content are regular. Making it a not so repetitve game in the end, and always enjoyable to play and progress.

The most dull and repetitive grind mixed with really sloppy shooting combines to make a really un-fun game.
Character grind is super long and they clearly just want you to spend money on the game. Genuinely might be better off playing a gatcha.
the game is fun and the main story is very interesting to play but the cut scenes do need a work on though
Too many OP builds and characters and people abusing them and destroying all the content in the game! I don't understand how they can ignore this problem.
